task_1.title: Update Apple platform and Apple Clang 17 support
task_1.description: The update expands Conan's recognized Apple OS, SDK, and compiler version settings to cover newer Apple releases, and adjusts the default C++ standard selected for apple-clang 17 so current Apple toolchains can be detected and configured without being treated as unsupported or falling back to an outdated default.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that Conan 2.15.1 recognizes the latest supported Apple platform, SDK, and Apple Clang versions, and that using apple-clang 17 produces an appropriate default C++ standard for modern Apple toolchains.

expectation.grounded: Conan settings validation should accept newly added Apple version values for `iOS.version` and `iOS.sdk_version` (`18.2`, `18.3`, `18.4`), `watchOS.version` and `watchOS.sdk_version` (`11.2`, `11.3`, `11.4`), `tvOS.version` and `tvOS.sdk_version` (`18.2`, `18.3`, `18.4`), `visionOS.version` and `visionOS.sdk_version` (`2.2`, `2.3`, `2.4`), `Macos.version` and `Macos.sdk_version` (`15.2`, `15.3`, `15.4`), and `compiler=apple-clang` with `compiler.version` `17` and `17.0`. When Conan computes the default C++ standard for `apple-clang`, versions earlier than `17` should keep the existing default, while version `17` and above should default to `gnu14`.
expectation.conceptual: Users targeting current Apple operating systems, SDKs, and Xcode toolchains should be able to declare those versions directly in Conan settings without unsupported-version failures. When Conan infers the default C++ standard for Apple Clang 17, it should choose a more modern default than older Apple Clang releases.

constraints.grounded: Previously supported Apple OS versions, SDK versions, SDK identifiers, and older `apple-clang` versions must remain valid. The change should be additive for Apple platform support, and the default C++ standard behavior for `apple-clang` versions below `17` must remain `gnu98`. Non-Apple compiler default C++ standard selection must remain unchanged.
constraints.conceptual: The upgrade must preserve backward compatibility for existing Apple configurations while adding support for newer Apple releases. Only the newly supported Apple versions and the default C++ standard for the newest Apple Clang generation should change; unrelated platform and compiler behavior should continue to work as before.

behavior: Conan accepts iOS `version` and `sdk_version` values `18.2`, `18.3`, and `18.4` as valid settings.
Conan accepts watchOS `version` and `sdk_version` values `11.2`, `11.3`, and `11.4` as valid settings.
Conan accepts tvOS `version` and `sdk_version` values `18.2`, `18.3`, and `18.4` as valid settings.
Conan accepts visionOS `version` and `sdk_version` values `2.2`, `2.3`, and `2.4` as valid settings.
Conan accepts Macos `version` and `sdk_version` values `15.2`, `15.3`, and `15.4` as valid settings.
Conan accepts `apple-clang` compiler versions `17` and `17.0` as valid compiler settings.
When Conan determines the default C++ standard for `apple-clang` version `17` or newer, it returns `gnu14` instead of the older Apple Clang default.
When Conan determines the default C++ standard for `apple-clang` versions below `17`, the default remains unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: When a user configures Conan with iOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, or Macos settings using the newly added OS or SDK version values from this release, Conan should accept those settings as valid.
When a user configures Conan with `compiler=apple-clang` and `compiler.version=17` or `17.0`, Conan should accept the compiler version as supported.
When Conan computes the default C++ standard for `apple-clang` version `17`, it should resolve to `gnu14`.
When Conan computes the default C++ standard for an older `apple-clang` version, it should continue to resolve to the prior default rather than changing behavior for existing toolchains.
When users keep existing supported Apple OS, SDK, and compiler settings, the upgrade should not invalidate or alter those previously supported configurations.
